messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "if next dose due in less than 2 days, skip missed dose and return to regular schedule"
set: ["if next dose due in less than 2 days, skip missed dose and return to regular schedule", "skip missed dose and return to regular schedule", "return to regular schedule after missed dose", "if more than 5 days late, skip missed dose and return to regular schedule", "skip the missed dose and use next dose at regular time", "skip missed dose if almost time for next scheduled dose", "skip the missed dose and take next dose at usual time", "Skip the missed dose", "skip missed dose if almost evening", "skip if almost time for next dose", "take next dose at regular time and stay on twice-daily schedule", "continue your regular dosing schedule after skipping the missed dose", "if more than 4 days have passed, skip the missed dose", "skip the missed dose if more than 5 days have passed", "if you take Horizant, skip the missed dose", "use next dose at regular time"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "skip missed dose and return to regular schedule",
    "return to regular schedule after missed dose",
    "skip the missed dose and use next dose at regular time",
    "skip the missed dose and take next dose at usual time",
    "skip the missed dose",
    "skip missed dose if almost time for next scheduled dose",
    "skip the missed dose if almost evening",
    "skip if almost time for next dose",
    "take next dose at regular time and stay on twice-daily schedule",
    "continue your regular dosing schedule after skipping the missed dose",
    "if more than 4 days have passed, skip the missed dose",
    "skip the missed dose if more than 5 days have passed",
    "if you take Horizant, skip the missed dose",
    "use next dose at regular time"
  ],
  "alias": "skip missed dose and return to regular schedule"
}
